open_questions: Dataset reproducibility vs a live DB: observe_projector snapshots farm_state.sqlite (1.26 GB, live, growing). manifest.json records mtime + sha256 of emitted files, but two runs on different days over the same query yield different datasets. Is a per-stamp snapshot sufficient for 'reproducibility', or should the layer pin a copy of the DB per campaign (disk cost)? Not decided by D1-D6.

search_history_ledger -> research_trial_count injection into a sealed DSR cohort: dsr_cohort.py is fail-closed and only accepts a sealed DL-089 ledger reconstruction (dsr_cohort.py:1-8, 628-663). Exactly how the research-search trial count augments effective_trial_count for a QM-RESEARCH-derived candidate without breaking the sealed-ledger invariant needs a concrete contract (a new source-of-trials field vs a wrapper cohort). Flagged as a design detail, not reopened.

id form: D5 fixes source_type=internal_research and QM-RESEARCH-YYYY-NNNN, but the qb_reputable_source_criteria.md convention is AI-<agent>-<tag>-<YYYYMMDD> (audit cards_r1_research.md 1a L36). Both are documented; confirm QM-RESEARCH- is the canonical prefix and AI-KIMI- is only an alias, to avoid two namespaces (INTERNAL_RESEARCH_SOURCE_CONTRACT.md territory).

Whether an internal-research card needs a distinct '## Research provenance' heading name that both the prescreen exemption and the mechanization_check exemption key on identically -- the exact heading string must be a shared constant between card_intake_prescreen.py and mechanization_check.py or the two exemptions can drift.
